question: How is the surpassing radiance of the vision described?
premises: The vision is equal to ten million moons
Its splendor is equal to all ten millions
inference: The vision shines with a radiance likened to ten million moons and all ten millions.
uncertainties: The exact sense of sarva-koṭi-sama-prabham is interpretive.
plain_english: O goddess, it is equal to ten million moons and has splendor equal to all ten millions.
